hypothesis: For each of the six fixed 3000-board source banks, the frozen largest-count-gap estimator recovers the exact graph in at least99% of independent nine-cell-per-board corruption draws.
primary_family: Six bank-specific exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson intervals at alpha=.05/6; all lower bounds must reach.99. Falsify the joint effect-size hypothesis if any upper bound is below.99; otherwise inconclusive.
secondary: N300 recovery, count thresholds and post-fit conditional noise bands are descriptive. No inference reruns for identical energies.
estimator: Same fixed rule: distinct sorted counts, first largest adjacent gap, floored midpoint; if all counts identical threshold0. No graph geometry or count-rank restriction enters construction.
corruption: Independent per-row uniform selection of9freecells via float64 random priorities with selection-boundary ties rejected; each selected digit independently replaced uniformly by a different digit. N300 is a prefix of N3000 within each draw.
validation: Every pair count independently reconstructed on CPU from archived cell changes;2GPU/CPU count parity draws per size per bank before continuing; all source/output identities retained. No graph truth in producer.
conditional_theory: Post-fit clean-input-only probability bands may use the true graph as a privileged diagnostic. Their separation-event union bound does not prove that the adaptive largest-gap threshold stays inside; do not report a conditional error guarantee merely from observing membership.
limits: Independent draws vary corruption of fixed training banks, not source-bank sampling or dataset distribution.
The six banks are evaluated separately; Bonferroni accounts for their joint primary claim.
The corruption mechanism preserves originally given clues and changes9of81cells per board.
The estimator and noise law were selected during prior studies; this is prospective replication with new noise streams.
Exact supports imply the previously audited energy, so redundant search would not add evidence.
